old: Forgiveness can’t be forced. It grows from understanding, and pushing it too early creates bypass. Staying angry forever can also let the injury keep governing the present. All of these can remain true together: the harm happened, the boundary still matters, the person remains accountable, and forgiveness may come later when your relationship to the event changes on its own.
new: There are a lot of times when we can not ‘force’ forgiveness on ourselves, it has to come from a place of understanding otherwise it can be bypassing. However, if we remain in the anger forever, we are allowing the injury to dictate how we live our lives in the present. So how do we hold all of this? We simply remember that it can all be true.

old: Advertising, fear, craving, screens, tribe, resentment, authority, loneliness, and repetition are already training the mind. Self-hypnosis lets you practice from inside it: befriending the deeper layers, listening closely, and making adult choice more available.
new: There are already a lot of forces out in the world that are training your mind very effectively. It would be wise to take a few ideas from them and use those self-hypnosis techniques for yourself. In this way you will learn to befriend the deeper part of your mind and listen to it, opening up a whole new area of choice for you as an adult.
